devdoc.details: Share price loss is tracked: - cumulatively (additive between subsequent txs) - relatively (as a percentage) - with a replenishing tolerance (based on time since last loss) This contract is version-agnostic, so long as the FundValueCalculatorRouter supports the fund's current version. Note that the FundValueCalculatorRouter is meant mostly for off-chain consumption (due to gas costs), but its gross share value functions are gas-efficient

executeCalls((address,bytes)[]).details: This doesn't need to be payable for Enzyme purposes

returns.shutdowner_: The user who can shutdown the smart account

init(address,address,uint64,uint32,addre.details: Pseudo-constructor to be called upon proxy deployment

getLossTolerance().notice: Get the cumulative loss tolerance percentage that is used for the throttle

userdoc.notice: A smart account that throttles the signer's atomic value loss to a fund, by tracking cumulative atomic losses to the fund's share price over a rolling duration
